mechaber/1:main: All eight days of Hanukkah, the Hallel is read. {Rama: And all eight days of Hanukkah, Tachanun [the supplication prayer], Tzidkatcha [the abridged supplication prayer said on the Shabbat], Lamenatzei'ach, and Tziduk hadin [the funeral prayer] are not said: [Mahril and Minahgim].}
